Structural protocol interface for bulk plan waypoint clearing and replacement.

class scarajectory.core.service.trajectory.plan.mutation.iplan_bulk_mutator.IPlanBulkMutator(*args, **kwargs)[source]¶

Bases: Protocol

Structural interface protocol for clearing and replacing plan waypoints.

It defines:

methods:
clear - Clears all waypoints from the plan.
set_waypoints - Replaces all waypoints with a new sequence.
